notes: Runs %p21spec_set_lock verbatim on its acquire path: with no lock present it writes ./lock.p21spec_creator (sysuserid + date/time) and assigns the _fn_lock fileref, then a follow-up DATA _null_ reads the lock back to confirm the guard fired. Only adaptation: the lockfile path is relative (driver passes an absolute run-folder path). The pinned log lines avoid the date/time inside the lock line, which reflects the run clock.
